Write the sample study for trying the AI flow

Source: R/ai_sample.R
tfl_ai_sample_study.Rd

Writes a made-up study, DMY-001 of Example Pharma, for trying the AI flow (the tflplanner AI tab, or tfl_ai_prepare()): the ADaM in adam/ and the documents an agent reads in inputs/. Everything is invented. No spec and no expected output is written: those are what the agent writes.

Usage

tfl_ai_sample_study(dir, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

dir

Folder to write into; made when missing. Put it where the agent's editor can open it (e.g. under the tflplanner home).

overwrite

Overwrite files already there? When FALSE (default), a file already there stops the call before anything is written.

Value

dir, invisibly. The paths written are in its attribute files.

Details

  • adam/: adsl, adae, adlb, advs and adtte, as SAS transport files (.xpt) when the haven package is installed, else as .rds. They are made from tflspec's bundled sample data; the arms are Placebo, Drug A 10 mg and Drug A 20 mg. advs is used by no shell.

  • inputs/toc.xlsx: the TOC (eight outputs; sheets TOC, Revision history, Notes).

  • inputs/shells.xlsx: the annotated shells, one per sheet (six shells), and General conventions, which is not a shell.

  • inputs/adam_spec.xlsx: the ADaM spec in the Pinnacle 21 form; inputs/define.xml: the same as define.xml.

  • inputs/sap.docx: the statistical analysis plan, a reference document.

Some points are left open in the documents on purpose: an agent should ask about them in the chat rather than decide them silently. GUIDE-ja.md, written beside the two folders, is the tester's guide in Japanese: from this call to step 4 of the AI tab.

Examples

d <- tfl_ai_sample_study(file.path(tempdir(), "DMY-001-inputs"))
list.files(d, recursive = TRUE)
#>  [1] "GUIDE-ja.md"           "adam/adae.xpt"         "adam/adlb.xpt"        
#>  [4] "adam/adsl.xpt"         "adam/adtte.xpt"        "adam/advs.xpt"        
#>  [7] "inputs/adam_spec.xlsx" "inputs/define.xml"     "inputs/sap.docx"      
#> [10] "inputs/shells.xlsx"    "inputs/toc.xlsx"
